title: Rang layega zaroor
body:
Rang layega zaroor
Toote teeron pe musalla, khoon-e-asgher se wazoo, Kis tarah tareekh ke dil se bhulaya jayega, Chhup na payegi sitam se teri mazloomi Hussain, Daastan-e-Karbala har aadmi dohrayega..
